InputMap.bindings:
move_x = d, a:-1, gamepad.lx, arrowright, arrowleft:-1
move_y = w, s:-1, gamepad.ly, arrowup, arrowdown:-1
look_x = gamepad.rx
look_y = gamepad.ry
attack = mouse_left, j, gamepad.x, gamepad.rt
roll = mouse_right, q, gamepad.b, gamepad.lt
jump = space, gamepad.a
dive = c, gamepad.rs
sprint = shift, gamepad.ls, gamepad.lb
interact = e, gamepad.y
pause = escape, gamepad.start
deadzone = 0.15

TerrainLayers.layers:
grass grass uv_scale=300 bump=0.02
rock dirt uv_scale=240 tint=0.8,0.76,0.72 bump=0.06
sand sand uv_scale=300 bump=0.01
forest dirt uv_scale=200 tint=0.5,0.58,0.36 bump=0.03

StateMachine.machine:
state idle clip=idle
state walk clip=walk speed=1.5
state run clip=run speed=1.35
state air clip=air
state attack clip=attack once
state roll clip=roll once
state swim clip=swim
state climb clip=walk speed=0.7
* -> roll when Hero.rolling == 1 fade 0.05
* -> attack when Hero.state == 1 fade 0.05
* -> swim when Hero.swim == 1 and Hero.state == 0 fade 0.2
* -> climb when Hero.climb == 1 and Hero.state == 0 fade 0.15
* -> air when Hero.air > 0.14 and Hero.state == 0 and Hero.swim == 0 fade 0.1
* -> run when Hero.sprint == 1 and Hero.state == 0 and Hero.swim == 0 and Hero.air < 0.14 fade 0.12
* -> walk when Hero.moving == 1 and Hero.state == 0 and Hero.swim == 0 and Hero.climb == 0 and Hero.air < 0.14 fade 0.12
* -> idle when Hero.moving == 0 and Hero.state == 0 and Hero.swim == 0 and Hero.air < 0.14 fade 0.2

Text.value: WASD walk   Shift run   Space jump / rise   C dive   RMB or Q roll   LMB swing the axe   walk into the ladder to climb

systems.name: clock
systems.doc: The hour of the day, and whether it is night.

systems.name: fog_mood
systems.doc: The mist takes the colour of the hour: pale blue by day, nearly black at night.

systems.name: eye_mood
systems.doc: The eye opens wide only in the dark.

systems.name: cam_look
systems.doc: The orbit camera: the mouse (or the right stick) turns it round the hero, the wheel pulls it in and out.

systems.name: hero_move
systems.doc:
Walk, run, jump, roll, swing the axe. The engine's `CharacterMotion` does the swimming (with `vertical`: Space rises, C dives), the roll (the request `roll` and the direction), the ladder (walk into it) and
the ledge (a jump against it); this system only sets the input and reads the state back for the animation.

systems.name: chop
systems.doc: A swing of the axe hits what is in front of the hero within reach; a tree or rock that has taken enough blows breaks into logs or stones.

systems.name: pickup
systems.doc: What falls is picked up by walking over it, after a moment.
